column1: # ci-pkg-times.tsv: seconds per package, the median "ok" time over the queue batches named below (packages none of
# them ran keep their earlier value). ci_shard.sh balances shards on it. <pkg> and its <pkg>#<label> entries are the
# split rows of a package in ci-splits.tsv: engine/rules 93/93/93/93 (372 s, four groups as of 11-27), testkit/
# conformance 119/85 (204 s), dirac/kgen 65/53 (118 s), bots/azmcts 84/33 (117 s), engine/effects 64/25 (89 s).
# 45940337816 (five-run medians). dirac/kgen, bots/azmcts and engine/effects are split only in the last two, so
# their halves are those runs' two-run medians. The prior 11-27 00:33-01:10Z basis held the three splits at their
# pre-split totals (kgen 77, azmcts 51, effects 81) and engine/rules at 219/153; measured as separate calls the
# halves are much larger, so the balancer under-counted every split entry and stacked the true-heavy ones.
# split-half attribution and the Golden chain heads exclusion are the script's).
